# Mantram AI

> Mantram AI is an agentic AI marketing operating system that learns a brand's
> DNA once and runs planning, content, creative, video, distribution and
> optimisation through 14 specialised AI studios. Built in India for D2C brands
> and agencies across South Asia, Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam,
> Indonesia) and the Middle East. Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil and
> other Indic languages natively via Sarvam AI; Arabic (dialect-aware, RTL),
> Bahasa Melayu, Bahasa Indonesia, Vietnamese and Thai via the multilingual
> frontier fleet; code-switched registers (Hinglish, Manglish, Singlish).
> Credit-pack pricing (₹149–₹17,999), no subscription. DPDP compliant,
> GDPR-aware.

## Platform
- [What is Brand DNA](https://mantram.ai/platform/brand-dna): structured,
  machine-readable brand profile read by all studios before generating.
- [Agent fleet](https://mantram.ai/platform/agent-fleet): model-agnostic routing
  across Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3 Pro, GPT-4o, GPT Image 2, NanoBanana 2,
  Flux Kontext, Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Seedance 2.0 Pro, Kling 3.0, HappyHorse 1.0,
  Sarvam AI and Bhasha models.
- [Fidato Nexus](https://mantram.ai/platform/fidato): natural-language command
  layer (⌘K) that executes actions across all studios.

## Studios
- [All 14 studios](https://mantram.ai/studios): grouped Plan (Research,
  Brainstorm, Monthly Strategy), Create (Content, Creative, Video, YouTube,
  Avatar, Brand), Distribute (Social Media, Performance Marketing, Funnel),
  Optimize (SEO+AEO, Retention).

## Regions & Languages
- [Multilingual marketing](https://mantram.ai/solutions/languages): 15+ languages, register-true.
